title: Course Schedule
tip: Cycle detection. Kahn or DFS colors.
statement:
There are `numCourses` labeled `0` to `numCourses - 1`. `prerequisites[i] = [ai, bi]` means you must take `bi` before `ai`.

Return `true` if you can finish all courses (the graph is a DAG).
followUp: Return a valid order (Course Schedule II).
editorial: Build adj + indegree. Queue zero-indegree. If you process all nodes, no cycle.
